description: This file defines the AstrologyActivity class for an Android app, which displays astrology details such as raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, and sunset times. It initializes UI components, uses AstrologyService to fetch astrology data, and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: AstrologyActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays astrology-related information such as raasi, nakshatra, sunrise, and sunset times. It initializes views and populates data using AstrologyService.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets up the UI and loads astrology details.

methods.name: initViews
methods.description: Initializes the TextView components by binding them to UI elements.

methods.name: loadAstrologyDetails
methods.description: Fetches astrology data from AstrologyService and updates the UI components.
